h1.title: See the stream, not just the picture
hero.subtitle: Paste an m3u8, MPD, or MP4. The picture stays on top. Bitrate, buffer, segments, and errors sit underneath. The file is not uploaded here.
placeholder.urlInput: Paste an m3u8, mpd, or mp4 URL
trust.text: Privacy: we do not store any video files — playback streams straight from the third-party origin of the URL you enter.
seo.title: StreamPlay — Play and inspect HLS, DASH, and MP4 in the browser
seo.description: Paste an m3u8, MPD, or MP4 and press play. Watch bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, and a segment timeline. When it fails, the page says what to try next. Media stays between your browser and the origin.
